headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. OAuth 2.1 with PKCE is the default: an OAuth-capable client gets a 401 with a resource_metadata challenge and signs in through the browser. Set this only for headless use, as a Bearer AgentPlaybooks user API key (for example: Bearer apb_live_...).
